label: Deepened diasporic double consciousness into stateless southern African exile
description: Head’s reflections on racialized outcast status in South Africa and Botswana extend Du Bois’s divided-self phenomenology into postcolonial exile.
dialecticalTension: Transforms national double consciousness into border-crossing existential survival.

label: Extended Fanonian colonial psychopathology to gendered exile in A Question of Power
description: In A Question of Power, Head dramatized the psychic torment of apartheid racialization and patriarchal exclusion as an inner metaphysical battleground.
dialecticalTension: Shifts anti-colonial psychiatry toward everyday agrarian ethics and inner spiritual resilience.
historicalContext: Published 1973; postcolonial Southern African philosophy and literature.
